name: Nintendo MMC5

components.role: MMC5 ASIC with PRG/CHR banking, protected PRG RAM, ExRAM, nametable routing, vertical split, extended attributes, scanline IRQ and multiplier
1 KiB MMC5 Expansion RAM used as CPU RAM, nametable RAM, extended-attribute storage and vertical-split source
Chip-local dual pulse and 8-bit PCM expansion-audio circuitry

connections: mapper.NametableMux -> Motherboard.Ciram.CE_BAR/A10 or mapper.ExRam/Fill data driver
notes: Mapper 5 MMC5. The package models the MMC5's PPU-bus snooping for in-frame/scanline detection, independent CIRAM/ExRAM/fill selection per nametable, extended attributes and vertical split without adding mapper semantics to the motherboard or generic compiler. Expansion audio remains cartridge-local until a generic analog cartridge path is modeled.
